annotations.title: Count the firm directory by country, kind, module or SAP signal

description: Answer a COUNTING question about the published firm directory in one call: how many organisations per country, per kind, per declared SAP module, or per SAP signal band — with the same `country`/`kind`/`module`/`query` filters `search_firms` takes, so you can count a slice as easily as the whole. Use this instead of paging `search_firms` and tallying rows: the directory holds thousands of organisations, and reading them all to produce a table of counts costs hundreds of calls and megabytes of rows for numbers Postgres computes in one scan. Every bucket is a value the directory actually stores; `value: null` is a real bucket meaning the field is unknown for those rows, and it is served rather than hidden — a country table that silently drops the rows with no country adds up to less than the population and says nothing about it.

by.description: Which facet to count on. Required — there is no default worth guessing.

country.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE, FR, CH.

kind.description: Restrict to one organisation kind before counting, same vocabulary as search_firms. Combining it with `by:"kind"` is legal and returns that single bucket.

module.description: Restrict to organisations with a DECLARED link to one SAP module code before counting, same vocabulary as search_firms' `module`. Combining it with `by:"module"` is legal and returns that single bucket (plus the null bucket).

query.description: Free-text filter, case-insensitive. EVERY word must appear in the record (substring per word, any order), so a natural-language phrase narrows the answer instead of having to match verbatim.

name: count_firms_by
title: Count the firm directory by country, kind, module or SAP signal
